0022600141.text: The Utah Jazz (1-3, 1-2 at home) are on a two-game losing streak and sit 13th in the West, while the San Antonio Spurs (2-2, 1-0 on the road) are on a two-game winning streak and sit 7th in the West. Out for Utah are Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), with Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and San Antonio won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 126-109 win in Salt Lake City on January 22, 2026.
